description: Canonical lifecycle-event taxonomy for guardrails (PAER: Policy over Action, Event binding, Rendering effect). An event answers WHEN a policy is consulted; the ACTION answers WHAT is being done. Event class decides decision semantics: a 'gate' event can carry allow/deny/ask; an 'observe' event is advisory only and can never deny; a 'lifecycle' event drives injection or the self-improvement loop.
